audience: finance and payment operations teams who move and track money with Modern Treasury

useCases.title: Check payment orders and expected payments
useCases.text: The AI lists payment orders and reads one by id. It also lists expected payments. You see what is still pending and who it is for. This reads only and approves nothing.

useCases.title: Review bank transactions on your internal accounts
useCases.text: The AI lists your internal bank accounts and the bank transactions, and reads one transaction by id. It sums up what came in and went out.

useCases.title: See which payments were returned
useCases.text: The AI lists payment returns, such as ACH returns, so you can see what failed and look into each one.

useCases.title: Look up counterparties and their bank accounts
useCases.text: The AI lists counterparties and their external bank accounts, and reads one counterparty by id. You see who you pay or get paid by.

useCases.title: Add a new counterparty record
useCases.text: The AI creates a counterparty (contact) record. It holds no bank details and moves no money.

useCases.title: Read ledgers, accounts, balances and entries
useCases.text: The AI lists double-entry ledgers and ledger accounts, reads one account with balances, and lists individual debits and credits.
